name: D2Repeatable
title: DHIS2 stage is repeatable
description: Whether one enrollment may capture this DHIS2 tracker program stage more than once. True means a person can be given several events of the stage - a follow-up visit, a repeat measurement - and false means the enrollment holds at most one. Only a tracker program stage form declares it, and it declares it either way, so a reader never has to guess.
